senses: palm, hand, sole, palm of the hand, hollow or flat of the hand
palm, hollow or flat of the hand
hollow, objects, bending objects, bent objects
hand-shaped branches or fronds (of palm trees)

strongs.def: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power
strongs.kjv: branch, [phrase] foot, hand((-ful), -dle, (-led)), hollow, middle, palm, paw, power, sole, spoon
